segment.description: Little Buffalo River (GNIS 01291406, HUC-8 06040004), the Buffalo-River-system stream of Lawrence County (headwaters and stocked course) flowing north into Lewis County to enter the Buffalo River near Napier - a separate water from the Buffalo River main stem and from Buffalo Creek (Grainger). TWRA's Trout MASTER layer places all 4 stocking/access sites on ~6 km of the Lawrence County course at 35.4001,-87.5127 / 35.3773,-87.5115 / 35.3631,-87.5112 / 35.3524,-87.5036 (24-hr gravel pull-offs, each under 25 spaces, contact TWRA Region 2); TDEC anchors coincide (TDECWPC-LBUFF010.4LW, LBUFF006.5LW in Lawrence; LBUFF000.8LS near the Lewis Co. mouth).
segment.boundaries: Catalog: 'TWRA spring-stocked Lawrence County creek in the Buffalo River system' - the stocked reach spans roughly RM 10.4 to 6.5 (TDEC river-mile anchors) NE of Lawrenceburg; lower Lewis County reach (USGS 03603660/03603693, RM 0.8) is unstocked country.

coldSource.notes: No dam and no documented spring influence on the stocked reaches. The only agency summer measurement on the creek is 21.5 C (2001-08-21, USGS 03603693 on the lower Lewis County reach) - warm Rim-stream behavior; the stocked Lawrence reach has May (18.6 C) but no June-September grabs.

holdover.detail: No holdover documentation found in any source checked. TWRA's 2026 row-level schedule stocks the creek only in 'Seasonal' weeks of 3/8, 3/22, 5/10 and 5/31/2026 (rainbow, Region 2) - a spring put-and-take calendar with no published between-stocking survival claim. NOTE a segment-vs-program discrepancy: the catalog carries seasonMonths 12/1/2 (programmatic winter), but the 2026 workbook rows and the MASTER layer's 'Spring' program label put the actual events in March-May; the wave-3 ledger made the same call, resolving a 'winter program near Lawrenceburg' hint to this spring fishery.

wildPopulation.detail: No wild trout documentation found. TWRA's trout regulations page (fetched 2026-09-18) names no Little Buffalo River entry - its only 'Buffalo' trout entries are Buffalo Creek (Grainger Co. WMA and delayed-harvest reaches), a different water - and no agency wild-trout reference was found.

overallSurvivalRead.oneLineWhy: The only agency summer measurement on the creek is 21.5 C in late August 2001 (lower reach) and TWRA's program is a four-week spring put-and-take rainbow fishery with no holdover, cold-source, or wild-trout evidence anywhere.
